subject: social_studies
concept: Evaluating a real current or historical international conflict from the perspectives of multiple involved parties
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's evenhandedness principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student maps the stated interests of each party involved in a described international conflict
exercise.abstract: Student presents the genuine perspective and interests of each side in a described international conflict, without asserting which side is right

assessment.mastery_threshold: presents each side's interests genuinely and specifically, without dismissing any side unfairly
misconception_flags: presents one side's perspective as obviously correct and the other as having no legitimate interests

interest_binding: conflict scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where age-appropriate
